name: Zombies

variantInfo.name: Zombie
notes: Level 13 Zombie (npc 26): 22 hitpoints, defence level 10, zero defensive bonuses, max hit 3 (crush).
Undead - the Salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.

variantInfo.name: Zombie
notes: Level 18 Zombie (npc 42): 24 hitpoints, defence level 18, zero defensive bonuses, max hit 2 (slash).
Spawns at the Graveyard of Shadows (Wilderness) as well as free-to-play areas. Undead.

variantInfo.name: Zombie
notes: Level 24 Zombie (npc 49): 30 hitpoints, defence level 16, bonuses stab +9 / slash +8 / crush +12 / magic +10 / range +11, max hit 3 (slash).
The wandering zombies at the Graveyard of Shadows (Wilderness levels 18-21) count towards a Krystilia task. Undead.

variantInfo.name: Vorkath
notes: Post-quest Vorkath counts for Zombies and Blue dragons tasks; use the same canonical post-quest variant as the Blue dragons task.
Requires Dragon Slayer II and dedicated dragonfire, venom and special-phase preparation. Not eligible for Krystilia because Ungael is outside the Wilderness.

variantInfo.name: Zombie pirate
notes: Wilderness Zombie pirates count for Zombies and Pirates tasks, including Krystilia assignments.
The surrounding Elder Chaos druids and other players are hazards; the Medium Wilderness Diary improves the zombie pirate loot chance.

variantInfo.name: Zogre
notes: Zogres count for Zombies and Ogres tasks.
Requires partial Zogre Flesh Eaters; prepare for disease and reduced damage without suitable ogre weapons or Crumble Undead.

variantInfo.name: Skogre (zombie task variant)
notes: Skogre NPC 878 counts for Zombies and Ogres; the visually similar NPCs 872 and 879 count for Skeletons and Ogres.
Requires partial Zogre Flesh Eaters; prepare for disease and reduced damage without suitable ogre weapons or Crumble Undead.

locationComparison.name: Graveyard of Shadows
notes: Wandering zombies (levels 18 and 24) roam the Graveyard of Shadows in Wilderness levels 18-21; these kills count towards a Krystilia Zombies task.
The Slayer_task/Zombies location table lists Graveyard of Shadows as 21 spawns, single-way, cannonable and safespottable; it is in the Wilderness close to the Ferox Enclave.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here (standard Wilderness cannon rules apply).

locationComparison.name: Common zombie spawns
notes: Common free-to-play zombie spawns count towards a Turael, Spria or Mazchna Zombies task.
Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated; conservative defaults are used.

taskNotes: Zombies are a shared task assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness, 75-125, weight 3) and by the starter masters Turael (15-30, w7), Spria (15-30, w7) and Mazchna (30-50, w7).
Krystilia kills only count in the Wilderness (e.g. the Graveyard of Shadows wandering zombies); starter-master kills count on common zombies anywhere.
Zombies are undead, so the Salve amulet (and its variants) and Crumble Undead apply.
slayerTargetId 273 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: 252 + worklist index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Zombies carry a 50% fire weakness; the level 24 zombie's lowest melee defence bonus is slash, so a slashing weapon with a Salve amulet is efficient.
No task extension unlock exists for Zombies.
Zombie pirates are a Wilderness alternative. Vorkath, Zogres and the zombie-category Skogre are non-Wilderness alternatives; their individual access and equipment requirements apply.
recommendedMethod: Kill zombies with a slashing melee weapon and a Salve amulet (they are undead). On a Krystilia task the kills must occur in the Wilderness - the Graveyard of Shadows wandering zombies are the canonical spot; bring risk gear.
